copy.heading: Swinging household objects
body: Returning golfers are known to swing whatever they are holding. The Programme's records include an umbrella at a bus stop, a rolled-up Sunday paper in the lounge, a French stick at a family meal, and the barbecue tongs, which hit a lampshade.
The swing is often done without the golfer noticing. It is a half-swing, stopping at the top, with a small look down the imaginary fairway. It is usually followed by a nod.
